_about: The converter drops the seven fields 0.7 removes: `transform_reverse` (on a `cc_params` and a `params` entry), `device.revision`, `device.transport.rate_limit_hz`, `sysex.footer`, `midi_out.note_offset`, `identity.sends` and `sources[].imported_at`, the date of a source being kept as the note `_imported_at` while the other removed fields are dropped. `device.rate_limit_hz`, `capabilities` and `_coverage` stay.
